description: Allow trusted CI to self-check engine/schema evolution PRs with the proposed validator while keeping head checkout and branch-push validation safe
rationale: Base engines cannot accept successor schemas; evolution PRs must self-validate and require human review; PR jobs must validate the head SHA not the merge commit
requirements: PR validation checks out and validates the pull request head SHA
Branch-creation pushes validate HEAD only rather than walking all history
Engine or schema evolution PRs self-check with the proposed engine and require human review
title: CI engine/schema evolution trust boundary
